The end of every affidavit should look like, 'That i swear (or I depose) to this affidavit in good faith believing the contents to be true and correct to the best of my knowledge and in accordance with the oaths act 2004, LFN.'.

 
It should always look like this, eg 'Sworn to at the high court registry of lagos state'.
